# PA Seniors

Use the space below to work with the dataset 'PASeniors' from the Lock5Data package.

```{r}
#load the dataset into your workspace
data(PASeniors)
PASeniors <- PASeniors |> na.omit()
xchisq.test(Allergies ~ Year, data = PASeniors)
gf_point(WorkHours ~ HWHours, data = PASeniors)
cor(ReactionTime ~ MemoryScore, data = PASeniors)
cor.test(ReactionTime ~ MemoryScore, data = PASeniors)
```

# Cars2020

Use the space below to work with the dataset 'Cars2020" from the Lock5Data package.

```{r}
data(Cars2020)

lm(HwyMPG ~ Weight, data = Cars2020)
60.524138 + (-0.006846 * 3500)
cor(Length ~ Weight, data = Cars2020)
summary(lm(Length ~ Weight, data = Cars2020))
```
